in_hebrew.name: Alcus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alcus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'alcus', meaning 'man' or 'warrior'. In Roman mythology, Alcus was the name of a god associated with agriculture and the harvest. In Christian context, this name can be seen as a symbol of strength and dedication.
